metadata.oracle: source-derived; request parsing is delegated to Burp IExtensionHelpers and was not executable in the reference checkout
evidence: src/main/java/burp/HttpAndHttpsProxy.java: empty-parameter handling and parameter-coverage key construction

rules.source_behavior: The reference source keys by raw request URL and appends an MD5 derived from the body byte-array string when it captured a non-null POST body; authentication data may also be appended.
rules.package_behavior: Uses an independent selected-field SHA-256 fingerprint over method, normalized URL, Content-Type, body-capture state, body bytes, and optional configured headers; authentication is a separate partition.
rules.difference: Fingerprint fields and encoding differ; filtering strategies are independent in this package.
rules.source: HttpAndHttpsProxy.java: request-key construction; Utils.java: request fingerprint calculation

rules.source_behavior: The reference source immediately drops every request whose parsed parameter list is empty, including the first; parameterized requests continue to subsequent filtering logic.
rules.package_behavior: Parameterized or incomplete requests pass; a complete empty request is allowed once per group and endpoint after commit, then repeats drop.
rules.difference: The first complete empty request passes in this package; strategies are independent and do not compose.
rules.source: HttpAndHttpsProxy.java: early return for an empty parsed parameter list

rules.source_behavior: The reference source keys by URL without query, parsed content type, and optional authentication data; parameter values become a presence marker, names are flattened across locations, and newly seen names are merged cumulatively.
rules.package_behavior: Independent coverage keyed by normalized endpoint, authentication group, method, scheme/host/port/path, and media type; coverage identity retains parameter location and name, ignores values, and tracks the empty shape.
rules.difference: Reference key omits method and flattened names lose location identity; package partitions by method and preserves locations.
rules.source: HttpAndHttpsProxy.java: parameter-coverage key construction; Utils.java: parameter-name serialization and duplicate detection

rules.source_behavior: Optional identity extraction selects parameter and header names matching token|auth|sessid|session case-insensitively; Proxy-Authorization also matches the auth substring.
rules.package_behavior: Cookie, Authorization, common token/auth/session headers, custom names, and caller AuthenticationGroupID create the group; Proxy-Authorization is excluded.
rules.difference: Package handles whole Cookie/Authorization sources and deliberately excludes proxy credentials.
rules.source: Utils.java: authentication parameter extraction and keyword matching; psc.config.yml: authentication-header matching configuration

cases.name: same parameter name in query and form keeps distinct locations
cases.reference_policy: If Burp returns both IParameter entries, the reference flattens both into one JSON key by name and replaces both values with the same marker; this package intentionally includes location in shape identity.

cases.name: Coverage strategy reference key omits HTTP method
cases.reference_policy: If both Burp requests expose the same parameter name and content type, the reference uses the same URL-without-query/content-type key and can drop the second request; this package intentionally partitions parameter coverage by HTTP method.
